instruction: Please enable cloud sync for my GIMP brushes and patterns so they sync across devices.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because GIMP does not have any built-in cloud synchronization features. GIMP is a standalone desktop application without cloud integration capabilities for syncing resources across devices.

llm_judge_reasons: Task correctly categorized as infeasible - GIMP does not have built-in cloud sync features for brushes and patterns
Evaluator correctly uses 'infeasible' function which is the appropriate marker for impossible tasks
Clear explanation provided in metadata explaining why the task cannot be completed
No verification logic needed since task is impossible to execute
